experiment.try: Scratch repo with a dirty tree; a smudge filter plays the live writer while git hard-resets; plain git merge vs Server/merge.mjs vs the guard.
experiment.measure: uncommitted record lines on disk afterwards; hidden WIP commits left behind
experiment.result: Plain git merge printed 'Index was not unstashed. Merge with strategy ort failed.' and lost every uncommitted line. merge.mjs lost none; the old no-overlap path left a hidden WIP commit (test fails on it).

decision.chose: git-guard blocks git merge, pull, rebase and --autostash in the main checkout (merge --abort/--continue/--quit and merge-base/-tree/-file stay open)
decision.why: the 2026-10-13 loss was an agent running plain git merge after merge.mjs refused; prose rules were already written and broken

decision.chose: Server/merge.mjs lands the no-overlap case through threeWay() too, so it never runs git merge
over: keep git merge when merge-tree says clean
decision.why: git parks and resets ANY dirty tree for a merge; threeWay already re-reads live logs at write time and commits through the index

decision.chose: re-append 301 lost lines (log, decision, experiment, review, flags, landing lines) from 4 hidden commits, pinned under refs/salvage/task-log-race-*
over: restore whole files from the hidden commits
decision.why: append-only and idempotent cannot overwrite newer state; assign/agent/file lines were skipped so an old copy cannot win last-line-wins; files/cards/usage snapshots skipped

assign.title: Record files: a plain git merge dropped appended lines
assign.outcome:
**Cause found, fixed, guarded, recovered.**

- ✅ Writer: a plain `git merge --no-ff` run in the dirty main tree at 17:38:07 (git parks the tree, hard-resets, the put-back failed). Not an autostash, not append.mjs, not LogSweeper; committed history never lost a line.
- ✅ Fix: git-guard refuses merge, pull, rebase and autostash in the main tree; `Server/merge.mjs` no longer runs `git merge`.
- ✅ Test: `Server/task-log-race.test.mjs` (13 checks; case 3 fails on the old merge.mjs).
- ✅ Recovered: 301 lines in 60+ files, including the figma-to-code, model-switch and session-dup-check landing lines.
- ✅ Rule: append only, in the commit-rule doc.
